title: Avenir Museum

services.name: Past Exhibitions
services.desc: Explore the Avenir Museum’s past exhibitions, their dates, images, and lasting impact. “What do you want to express in your world?” This simple question guides the design work of northern Colorado artist, Julie Rieken. The response to this question? Moments of Rieken’s life, rendered in embroidery, beading, and found objects that adorn a dazzling display of fifty-eight narrative mixed-media textile objects- all captured within the familiar shape of a holiday stocking. The title of this exhibition is the common response to a compliment directed towards a dress, skirt, or other garment that is typically designed without pockets. services.name: Programs and Events
services.desc: Our programs and events highlight the wide range of the Avenir’s current exhibitions, as well as guest presenters on unique subjects. Join us for these free, public lectures on an intriguing array of textile topics! Drop in to our monthly Make & Mend Open Studio, where we welcome all textile-based projects! Whether you’re into upcycling, mending, fabric DIY, cosplay, stuffy repair, quilting, or anything else textiles, this is the perfect space to get creative. Basic materials will be provided, but if you have specific fabric, thread, or tools you’d like to use, feel free to bring them along!
